name: designmd-forge
description: Free, offline MCP server for browsing/searching/fetching DESIGN.md design-system specs (colors, typography, components) across web, mobile and iOS sources, with lint/diff/scaffold authoring tools.

scripts.refresh-data:web: rm -rf .repo-tmp && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/VoltAgent/awesome-design-md.git .repo-tmp && node scripts/build-index-web.mjs .repo-tmp && rm -rf .repo-tmp
scripts.refresh-data:mobile: rm -rf .repo-tmp-mobile && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/TrustOtc/awesome-mobile-design-md.git .repo-tmp-mobile && node scripts/build-index-mobile.mjs .repo-tmp-mobile && rm -rf .repo-tmp-mobile
scripts.refresh-data:ios: rm -rf .repo-tmp-ios && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/meliwat/awesome-ios-design-md.git .repo-tmp-ios && node scripts/build-index-ios.mjs .repo-tmp-ios && rm -rf .repo-tmp-ios
scripts.refresh-data: npm run refresh-data:web && npm run refresh-data:mobile && npm run refresh-data:ios && npm run load-data

author: adelpro
